aurex-browser.description:
Aurex Browser — A fast, lightweight, and 100% open-source web browser built for speed, privacy, and seamless media control.

🚀 Key Features:

⚡ Fast Download Manager
🎬 Built-in Video Player & Downloader
🛡️ Ad & Popup Blocker
🔞 Adult Content Blocker
🔒 Locked Private Tabs
🎨 Fully Customizable
💻 Open Source & Private
